Alisha (CEO): @here Quick heads-up — town hall tomorrow at 10:30am PT. Please read the agenda below and drop any Qs you want covered.Recording will be posted after. :calendar:

Ben (VP Eng): Agenda preview: short updates + 3 lightning demos + customer highlight + Q&A. Aim for 45m total.

Carmen (Product): Can we collect 1-2 bullet questions per team in this thread? We'll bundle similar ones. Prefer product/strategy questions up front.

Dave (Ops): Note: Friday deploy window will be slightly delayed if we hit extended Q&A. Plan accordingly.

Alisha (CEO): Quick agenda snippet (keep to one line each):
```
- Company pulse (Alisha)
- Platform priorities & Dedicated launch status (Ben)
- Customer story: Raccoon Health (Carmen)
- Reliability updates & incident safeguards (Dave)
- Lightning demos: 3 teams, 5m each
- Open Q&A (15m)
```

Ben (VP Eng): If your team wants to demo, DM me with title + 1 slide. Deadline EOD today.

Carmen (Product): For async folks: drop questions here and mark them with "Q:" at the start. We'll surface top ones live and link the full list in the recording notes.

Emily (Allhands Bot): Calendar invite created: https://company.calendar/meet/10-30-allhands — recording will be available in ~1h after end.

Raj (Platform Eng): Q: Any changes to rollout cadence for Dedicated?

Alisha (CEO): Raj — we'll cover high level tomorrow; short answer: no change to GA target but slightly shifted rollout zones to prioritize regulatory customers. Details in Q&A.

Lina (Support): Q: Where will postmortems live if incidents are mentioned?

Dave (Ops): Lina — incident notes will live in #postmortems and linked from the Allhands recording page. We'll avoid naming customer specifics unless cleared.

Marta (Sales): Q: Can we get a one-liner on pricing changes for Dedicated? Team needs to prep customer comms.

Carmen (Product): Marta — brief price guidance will be given; channel will get exact messaging after the meeting.

Ben (VP Eng): Reminder: demos should focus on measurable impact (latency, cost savings, user/customer metric). Slides should be one slide + a short demo link.

Alisha (CEO): One more ask: each leader, bring one thing you want the company to celebrate and one thing you want folks to help with. Fast pulse-check.

Noah (Eng): Dropping demo request: "KV-cache tuning -> 2x cost reduction" DMed Ben.

Carmen (Product): Thanks — noted.

Alisha (CEO): Post-meeting takeaways we plan to publish: 3 bullets of wins, 2 ops asks, 1 product follow-up, recording link, and full Q&A doc. We'll pin that in #all-hands.

Ben (VP Eng): Heads-up: we'll mention a small change to default batching config for new Dedicated clusters — ops will post the config snippet and rollout plan after the call.

Dave (Ops): Config snippet preview: ```
default_batch_size: 64
default_max_latency_ms: 180
rolling_restart: true
```

Alisha (CEO): Thanks all. If you can't make it, please leave your Qs here by EOD and someone will raise them. See you tomorrow. :sparkles:
